41358-practical-mind-reading-a-course-of:
William Walker Atkinson's Practical Mind-Reading, a course of lessons on thought-transference, telepathy, mental currents, and mental rapport, was issued by the Advanced Thought Publishing Company of Chicago. Copyrights of 1907 and 1908 stand on it. The title page promises plain instruction that any person of average intelligence can master and demonstrate.

Lesson one takes up the nature of mind reading, framed as mind acting on mind, a sort of mental wireless telegraphy. Lesson two gives the proofs, drawn from recent experiments. Contact mind reading follows, with its nerve currents passing from transmitter to receiver. Development exercises and simple demonstrations prepare the student for harder feats: the banknote test, blackboard work, and telepathic chess and checkers.
doe-osti-2589500-dynamic-capacitive-wire:
Project CRD-12-00480, on charging electric cars while they drive, closes with National Renewable Energy Laboratory final report NREL/TP-5400-96829. Technical contact Bingrong Sun covers a University of Colorado Boulder approach that sends power through capacitive plates rather than magnetic coils. Coil systems need heavy ferrite cores, which are costly and hard to bury in roadways.

Capacitive coupling promises hardware that is smaller, lighter, and cheaper to embed in pavement. Cars could then carry smaller batteries, easing the cost, range, and charging time problems that slowed electric car adoption. Laboratory work under the project developed and tested the transfer system design. The filing stands as the closeout record for this branch of the dynamic charging work, one of several paths toward roads that power the vehicles using them.
